Class StructureSubSection

java.lang.Object
nl.pim16aap2.animatedarchitecture.core.config.StructureSubSection
All Implemented Interfaces:
IStructureSubSection
Direct Known Subclasses:
StructureSubSectionSpigot
public class StructureSubSection extends Object implements IStructureSubSection
Represents a subsection of StructuresSection in the configuration.

This class is used to define a subsection for a specific structure type.
